scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the planned protective-filter swap on the custom viola earplugs before tonight’s amplified rehearsal.
Emerging Need: The swap is underway, but the left sleeve’s retention ring fails and the filter will not seat, so the same preparation activity has stopped.
Decision Context: Current schedule and service-window notices define whether same-day bench help can still support the attempt; saved audiology guidance distinguishes safe next steps from improvising.
Consequence: If the same-day window closes, the earplug setup remains blocked for the rehearsal rather than merely unfinished or optional.

parameter.title: North Loop amplified rehearsal
parameter.description: Full ensemble rehearsal with amplified playback check; standard call remains 18:00.
parameter.location: North Loop Arts Annex Studio B

parameter.subject: Tonight's amplified rehearsal notes
parameter.body: Tonight's North Loop rehearsal will use close mics, a click feed, and the added percussion riser. Please bring your usual musician hearing protection; the sound check schedule will not pause after call time for personal gear issues.

parameter.content: Starting the filter swap on my custom plugs now so the 25 dB set is seated before dinner. Right side first, then the left.
Right plug is done, but the left sleeve's retention ring pulled loose and the 25 dB filter will not stay in. I stopped the swap; the little kit tool just bends the ring outward.

parameter.subject: Musician-fit desk hours for today
parameter.body: Day-of reminder: the musician-fit bench is open today until 4:30 PM. Messages received by 4:05 PM can still be reviewed for same-day filter-carrier help. Please include the shell serial if you are asking about a custom plug.

parameter.subject: Same-day musician-fit desk is now closed
parameter.body: The musician-fit bench has closed for today. New filter-carrier questions can be queued for the next bench opening on Friday afternoon.
